A list of revenue paths assessed from market evidence, not wishful thinking.
The order follows the ratio between probability of success and time until money comes in. The fastest
is selling skills, not waiting for a trading strategy to beat the market.
done.130:
The strongest evidence currently supports services and bounties, not trading. Market rates for
data work are far more certain than the return of any strategy.
